description: Describe the registries DevicErts compiles (EUDAMED, FDA GUDID, 510(k), De Novo, PMA, recalls, establishment registrations): region, record count, last sync date, sync cadence and reuse terms of each, plus the catalogue totals. Takes no arguments. Use when the question is how current or complete the data are, or under which terms they may be reused. Do not use for facts about a device or a company (use search_devices or search_manufacturers). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.
name: get_data_sources
title: Data sources and freshness
